# lmsgo — LM Studio CLI for Claude Code

Delegates bulk file I/O from Claude Code to a local LM Studio model.
Single Go binary, no dependencies.

**Rule: Claude = thinking. LM Studio = I/O.**

## When to use

| Use lmsgo | Do NOT use lmsgo |
|-----------|-----------------|
| 3+ files to read | Tasks < 2000 tokens |
| Any single file > 400 lines | Debugging |
| Doc updates after a session | Architecture decisions |
| Generating boilerplate / test files | Security-sensitive code |
| Config scaffolding | Anything needing exact line numbers |

## Commands

### ask — answer a question across files

```
lmsgo ask --question "..." <file|dir> [<file|dir>...]
          [--glob PATTERN]       # filter files when a directory is given
          [--max-tokens N]       # default: 8192
```

Examples:

```bash
lmsgo ask --question "Where are JWT tokens validated?" src/auth/
lmsgo ask --question "What env vars does this app require?" main.go config.go
lmsgo ask --glob "*.java" --question "Where is the DB pool configured?" src/
```

### write — generate a file from a spec

```
lmsgo write --spec "..." --target <output-path> [context-file...]
            [--max-tokens N]     # default: 16384
            [--dry-run]          # print output instead of writing
```

Examples:

```bash
lmsgo write --spec "Go table-driven tests for UserService" \
            --target internal/user/service_test.go \
            internal/user/service.go

lmsgo write --spec "Dockerfile for a Go app" --target Dockerfile --dry-run
```

### extract — strip a Claude Code session to readable text

```
lmsgo extract [-o output-file] [--last N] <session.jsonl>
```

Flags must come **before** the positional `<session.jsonl>` — Go's `flag` package stops parsing at the first non-flag argument.

Examples:

```bash
lmsgo extract -o /tmp/chat.txt ~/.claude/projects/my-project/session.jsonl
lmsgo extract --last 20 ~/.claude/projects/my-project/session.jsonl
```

Typical follow-up:

```bash
lmsgo ask --question "What doc updates are needed? Give exact edits." \
          /tmp/chat.txt docs/architecture.md
```

### setup — first-run configuration

```
lmsgo setup [--model NAME] [--dry-run]
```

Detects LM Studio models, writes env vars to a sourceable file, and appends
the Claude Code routing snippet to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md.

### version

```
lmsgo version
```

## Environment variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| LMS_BASE_URL | http://localhost:1234/v1 | LM Studio API base URL |
| LMS_MODEL | local-model | Model ID from /v1/models |
| LMS_API_KEY | lm-studio | Ignored by LM Studio |

Set via `lmsgo setup` or manually in your shell profile.

## Prerequisites

LM Studio must be running: `lms daemon up`
Verify: `curl http://localhost:1234/v1/models`
